summary: CSL's fourth major guidance reset — US$5B Vifor impairments, FY26 NPATA US$3.1B below consensus — triggered its biggest ever single-day fall (-16.82%), removing ~31 XJO index points and crashing XHJ -6.47%. The US ATH signal (SPX +0.84%) was entirely absorbed by the CSL event. XSO outperformed (+0.25%) in Neutral Bull regime while XJO/XAO/XTO remain Neutral Bear — active regime divergence. OML +7.14% on second competing takeover bid (I Squared Capital $1.45/share). RBA at 4.35% post-hike (8-1 vote). Federal Budget tomorrow 12 May is the next critical macro event.
